PREPARATION FOR TRANSFER AT THE JUNIOR LEVEL Prerequisites for this major are not offered at California community colleges; however, students will be admitted to the Scandinavian major without the 2-course elementary language prerequisites and the cultural studies prerequisites Scandinavian 60 and 75 as it is possible to complete all requirements for this major upon admission to UC Berkeley. A choice of one of five concentrations is available: Old Norse Studies, Danish, Finnish, Norwegian, or Swedish language and culture. The relevant lower-division language prerequisites are applied to one of the five Scandinavian major concentrations upon transfer. The two cultural studies prerequisites are taken upon entry: Scandinavian 75 (Nordic Culture and Values) in the Fall Semester and Scandinavian 60 (Heroic Legends of the North) in the Spring Semester. The elementary first-year language sequences, noted below, are started during the student's first Fall semester at Berkeley. The required 4-semester language sequence is completed in the two years following admission. Once admitted, students who have a prior background in their proposed target language (Finnish, Danish, Icelandic, Norwegian, or Swedish) will be required to take a language proficiency test and consult with the department language program coordinator for placement in the correct language course level. The use of Latin 1 and 2 for the Old Norse concentration is also assessed upon admission.
